title: Schedule of Redemption Deposits by Late-Fee Record, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Redemption deposit — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement under a notice of intent to tow.** A redemption deposit is added to the redemption amount and held as a credit on the agreement:

| Late fees posted on the agreement in the last 12 months | Redemption deposit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $40.00 |
| exactly 2 | $20.00 |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |

**Notes.**
- Every late fee entry posted on the agreement in the window counts.
- A window of the last 12 months covers ledger entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month; a late fee is placed in it by its posting date.
- The deposit is part of the amount paid on redemption and stands afterwards as a credit on the agreement.

Hypothetical readings: late fees posted 2, 6 and 13 months before the handling date: 2 in the window, deposit $20.00. Late fees posted 1, 3, 5 and 9 months before: 4 in the window, deposit $40.00.
